ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is only used while you use the app, to show nearby charging points, the distance to them and as the starting point of your trips. It is never stored on a server.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: If you allow it, ads can be more relevant to you. We never sell your data and the app works the same if you don't allow it. Premium has no ads.
